Check: PostHog script initialises exactly once per page load
How to Verify: DevTools Console — check for duplicate init warnings

Check: Network requests go to eu.i.posthog.com and return 200
How to Verify: DevTools Network — filter by posthog

Check: Events carry site_platform: 'webflow' and site_version: 'cms-cutover-2026'
How to Verify: PostHog Activity tab — inspect event properties

Check: GA4 and Cookie3 do NOT load before consent is given
How to Verify: DevTools Network — check no gtag or cookie3 requests on fresh load

Check: After accepting consent, GA4 and Cookie3 load and fire correctly
How to Verify: DevTools Network — confirm scripts load after accept

Check: After rejecting consent, zero PostHog network requests are made
How to Verify: DevTools Network — filter by posthog after reject

Check: $pageview fires on each page load
How to Verify: PostHog Activity tab

Check: marketing_cta_click fires with correct cta_type and widget_param for each button
How to Verify: Click each CTA, verify in PostHog Activity

Check: marketing_external_link_click fires for external links with correct link_category
How to Verify: Click external links, verify in PostHog Activity

Check: marketing_external_link_click does NOT fire for app.the client product links
How to Verify: Click app links, confirm no event in PostHog Activity

Check: marketing_external_link_modal_shown fires when modal opens
How to Verify: Test with a developers.the client product link

Check: marketing_external_link_confirmed fires on confirm click
How to Verify: Confirm in modal, verify in PostHog Activity

Check: marketing_scroll_depth fires at 25/50/75/100% thresholds
How to Verify: Scroll through a long page, verify in PostHog Activity

Check: marketing_section_view fires as sections enter viewport
How to Verify: Scroll through page, verify section events in PostHog Activity

Check: app_name: 'marketing' is present on every event
How to Verify: PostHog Activity tab — inspect any event

Check: distinct_id is consistent across pages in the same session
How to Verify: Navigate multiple pages, compare distinct_id

Check: Clicking app.the client product link appends __ph_id and __ph_session_id to URL
How to Verify: Click app link, inspect URL in new tab

Pass?: NO-GO CONDITIONS — BLOCK CUTOVER IF ANY ARE TRUE

Check: PostHog initialises more than once on a page
How to Verify: DevTools Console

Check: Events missing site_platform or site_version
How to Verify: PostHog Activity tab

Check: Critical events only firing via autocapture (not explicit posthog.capture())
How to Verify: PostHog Activity — check event source

Check: app.the client product links not carrying __ph_id / __ph_session_id
How to Verify: Click app link, inspect URL

Pass?: STAGE B — POST-CUTOVER (first 48h on the client product)

Check: sky_consent cookie is scoped to domain=.the client product
How to Verify: DevTools → Application → Cookies

Check: Returning users who accepted on old site are NOT re-prompted
How to Verify: Test with a browser that has legacy localStorage consent

Check: Returning accepted users skip banner and PostHog inits with persistence: 'localStorage+cookie'
How to Verify: DevTools Console + Network

Check: distinct_id is consistent for returning user across old → new site
How to Verify: PostHog person profile — compare IDs

Check: Event volume comparable to pre-cutover baseline
How to Verify: PostHog dashboards — no unexpected drops or spikes
